gates.scope: Authenticated active-Admin GET performs Type, ERP-state, exact business_ref, and normalized text filtering with a hard 500-row projection ceiling; UUID references are enriched by one bounded canonical leads query. POST strictly validates 1..500 unique edits and delegates one atomic batch to Migration 049.

Each row reuses SearchableSelect for existing canonical ERP, normalized custom ERP, explicit None, and exact manual-baseline clear. Drafts retain their exact segment/business identity across filter changes for one multi-row atomic save.

Rows show canonical lead display name when an exact UUID lead exists, stable business reference, Type, Current ERP, Latest visit, Source, and Last updated. Latest visit is projected separately from the winning ERP fact timestamp.

Stale responses are ignored, refresh retains draft edits, failed reads/writes expose bounded safe messages, failed atomic writes retain all drafts, and successful writes refresh both editor data and ERP intelligence.

ERP Intelligence exposes a separate Manage Current ERP opener; sources read Field Visit, Admin, or Not captured; filters read All/Retailers/Distributors and All states/Not captured/ERP assigned/None; the atomic batch CTA reads Save N changes.

The focused A02 suite passed 6 tests covering None/Not captured distinction, normalization, bounded Admin/RPC contract, display-name enrichment, exact UI labels, SearchableSelect edit modes, and draft preservation; product typecheck also passed.
Targeted ESLint passed for the route, editor, domain helper, page integration, and focused test; changed tracked content passes git diff --check and new files contain no trailing whitespace.
